author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Get up-to-date with the newest changes in Microsoft Copilot. With new features and interface changes constantly rolling out, it’s important to stay up to date on the most important new features in Copilot. 

This video clarifies the changes to Copilot paid subscriptions now that upgraded Copilot features are included in Microsoft 365 subscriptions. This video also shows how to use the Temporary Chat for Copilot requests you do not want saved in your chat history, as well as two very powerful Excel tools – App Skills and Agent mode.

What you’ll learn:
• Updates to Copilot subscription plans – No more Copilot Pro
• Temporary Chats – Copilot requests that are not saved in Chat History
• Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint – Available to more users
• Use Copilot App Skills in Excel to modify a spreadsheet
• Agent Mode in Excel – modify and generate workbooks based on research
